title: Indian Oil dividend announcement 2025 in Q4 results; date, schedule fixed | Quarterly earnings
summary: Indian Oil has fixed the date and schedule to announce its dividend as part of its fourth-quarter 2025 results, according to a report published on Apr 17, 2025. The article does not specify the dividend amount, record date or payment timetable; investors should await the company’s full Q4 earnings release for complete details.
content:
Markets

Written by: ET Now Digital

Updated Apr 19, 2025 10:34 IST

Indian Oil dividend announcement 2025 in Q4 results; date, schedule fixed (Pic: ET NOW)

Indian Oil has fixed the date and schedule for announcing its dividend in connection with its fourth-quarter results for 2025. The notice of a scheduled dividend announcement was published alongside the Q4 results coverage, but the article text available does not provide specifics on the dividend quantum, record date or payment date.

Investors and market participants should look for the companys formal Q4 earnings release and board resolution for full details, including dividend amount, ex-dividend and record dates, and the payment timetable. Such information is typically disclosed in the official earnings release and regulatory filings.

This report was published by ET Now Digital. Further updates and the complete dividend schedule should be available when Indian Oil files its detailed Q4 results and accompanying disclosures.

Source: ET Now Digital

End of article
